note: Copy to data/metadata/<dataset>/samples.ledger.json next to samples.tsv. One ledger row per sample. 'nesting' lists replication levels coarse to fine; 'unit_of_replication' is the independently assigned unit the model will treat as n; 'batch' lists crossed nuisance variables (calendar dates, runs), never a nested level at or below the unit. Check it with: data_contract_check.py --ledger <this file>.
